Worshiped with the flowers of self-born existence.
The self-generated one who arises from the blossom of existence.
The one who is self-existent and blooms in pure, flower-like perfection.
Described as the self-born flower, revealing the Divine as spontaneously self-manifest.
The wise worshipper of the self-existent Lord.
The self-born Matrika, tender of the sacred fire that burns away impurity.
The self-existent giver and protector of all beings.
The Self-existent One, the devotee, and the one of pious disposition.
The all-knowing one whose wisdom blossoms forth spontaneously from within.
Beloved of those who worship the Self-born One, Shiva, the primordial unmanifest reality.
The Self-Existent One who is the support of those who praise and worship.
The Destroyer of those who revile the Self-existent One, revealing Her fierce protective power.
The Giver of self-born, all-pervading divine essence.
The Giver of Sons and Daughters to Self-Born Beings.
The self-existent one who bestows joyful smiles.
The Self-expanding and Self-manifesting Form of the Divine.
Delighted with all manifestations arising from the flow of Time.
The innermost Soul and Origin of all forms arising from Time.
The origin and source of everything that arises from Time (Kala).
The origin of all the worlds.
Ever loving the jasmine flower.
Ever delighting in red hibiscus flowers.
Delighting in the fragrant lotus-like flowers born from Shiva's matted locks.
The Self that arises from the white lotus and the red lotus, representing Shiva and Shakti in creative union.
The self-existent and unoriginated One.
The one who is the power of the auspicious, Lord Shiva.
The Purifier who cleanses, sanctifies, and makes all things holy.
The Purifier of all the Worlds.
The Illustrious and Glorious One, honored for Her fame and splendor across the worlds.
The embodiment of supreme intelligence, wisdom, and unshakable recollection.
She who is free from all mental defilements, embodiment of pure consciousness and divine wisdom.
The Beautiful Goddess, Delightful to the Devas.
The divine energy that pervades and rides upon the cosmic horse of creation, symbolizing speed, healing, and light.
The one who cuts, showing Her power to sever karmic bonds and ignorance.
The Nourisher, the Sustainer, and the Giver of strength and fullness, reflecting the constellation Pushya.
Radiant with divine light and power, she is the manifest form of pure splendor.
The Lunar Orb, radiant and cool.
The Subtle One, beyond material perception and gross manifestation.
The Giver of Subtle Knowledge.
The Destroyer of subtle and gross fears.
The Bestower of Boons and the Giver of Fearlessness.
The Destroyer of all bonds and limitations, granting liberation.
The One Whose Desires Manifest all of Creation.
The Fulfiller of all desires.
The Patient One, who endures all to protect her devotees.
The Goddess whose presence desires and creates, the yoni-goddess.
The Beautiful One of the Sacred Family, or of the Lineage.
The Giver of happiness and bliss.
The Bestower of Sorrow.
Conferrer of liberation and spiritual freedom.
The Illuminator of the meaning and path of liberation.
The One Who Bestows Both Unholy and Holy Thoughts (for the evolution of consciousness).
She who destroys all deeds and actions, clearing the way to final liberation.
She who bears and sustains Shukra, the vital essence and creative potency.
Whose form is the essence of creation and prosperity.
Dweller in the Ocean of Pure White Potency, a Source of all Creation.
The Abode of Pure Brightness and Essence.
The Goddess who enjoys all pleasures and bestows them upon Her devotees.
Eternally Delighting in the Worship of the Seminal Essence of Creation, the Pure and Auspicious.
Revered by Shhukra (Venus), the Guru of the Asuras.
One who is pleased by the performance of the Shukra Homa (fire ritual dedicated to the planet Venus).
The one who is beloved by Shukra (Venus), bestowing prosperity and divine grace.
The Embodiment of Immaculate Purity and the Seminal Essence of Creation.
The Embodiment of Purity and Radiance, the Luminous Form.
The daughter who worships the Guru, or the daughter who reveres the planet Venus.
The Essence of Venus, symbolizing purity and generative power.
The Pure, White, and Radiant One.
Filled with the desire for light and purity.
The Beautiful One who is the very essence of the life-giving creative force.
She who is immersed in the vital essence, the primordial creative force.
She who creates and manifests the seminal essence, the source of all generation.
She who is served by Shhukra and who herself is radiant, pure, and full of vital essence.
The Great Essence, the supreme vital force and creative principle.
She who is the very nature of creative essence and generative power.
She who bestows the abundant shower of vital essence and spiritual energy.
She who is known as the essence of purity and creative force.
She who is worthy of Shukra's worship, the one adored by Venus.
She who is worshipped by the worshippers of Shukra and by Shukra himself.
She who brings forth the bliss of the vital creative essence.
She who bestows the eternal bliss arising from the pure vital essence.
The festival and celebration of the vital creative principle.
She who is eternally full of the pure divine essence.
She who is delightful and charming as the vital creative principle.
She who is everything to those who worship the vital essence.
The annihilator of those who revile the divine creative essence.
She who is the very essence of शुक्र (Shukra), the principle of purity, radiance, and life-giving brilliance.
She who gathers, enriches, and attracts the potency of Shukra, the creative seed-essence that sustains manifestation.
She who dries up the blood, revealing her power to destroy evil at its very source.
The one for whom blood, or Rudhira, is an offering and nourishment.
Constantly Delighted by the Offering of Blood.
Worshipped with blood offerings, symbolizing the force of life itself.
She who is worshipped through the offering of sacrificial blood.
Dwelling in blood, signifying her fierce and primordial presence within the vital life-force.
Fond of blood, destroyer of evil, and giver of liberation.
She of blood-red hue, manifesting fierce power and dynamic energy.
She whose body is red, radiant with the fierce hue of passion and destruction.
She whose children are worshipped through blood.
She whose radiance shines blood-red, blazing with fierce power.
She whose longing is for blood, the devourer of sin and ignorance.
The Resplendent Goddess, Beautiful and Red-hued, who embodies the vibrant energy of creation and passion.
She whose essence is blood, signifying her fierce and life-sustaining power.
Worshipped by Blood.
She who is adored from the cave of blood, the hidden chamber of life-force and fervent devotion.
The Great Red One, radiant with life-force, passion, and terrible power.
The One whose very nature is blood, revealing her fierce and consuming power.
The One who brings forth and sustains the red flow of life.
Bathed in Blood.
Bathed in Blood, Fierce Protectress Adorned with Ruddy Hues.
The blood-red Devi, served and praised by the blood-drinker, the Red One.
She who delights in blood, revealing her fierce joy in the destruction of evil.
The giver of blood-pleasure and bliss.
Possessing a heart filled with devotion and compassion.
The one who is always full of blood.
She who is adored by the color of blood and is pleasing to the mind.
She who is everything to those worshippers who offer even their life-force to her.
She who destroys those who revile the sacred principle of Rakta.
The Soul of Blood, embodying the vital essence and primordial energy of existence.
The Red-Formed One, emanating the vibrancy of life and primal energy.
The One who draws forth blood, summoning and subduing vital essence itself.
The One who is delighted by blood, revealing her fierce and protective power.
The Blood-thirsty Tiger, expressing fierce and untamed power.
She who is intent on drinking blood, the destroyer of negative forces.
The Mother who delights in the offering of blood.
The one whose form is as smooth and loving as the surging waves.
The Goddess Residing within the Devotee's Heart.
Daughter of the Mountains.
The Destroyer of sin and impurity.
Residing in the hearts of the virtuous.
She who bestows bliss upon the spiritual aspirant.
The Mother of All Seekers and Spiritual Aspirants.
The Loving Doer of good to devotees.
The Bestower of the Abundance of Great Joy and Infinite Bliss upon the Aspirant.
The Breath and Life Force of the Devotee.
Whose mind is ever attached to the devotee.
The supreme essence and ultimate possession of all spiritual aspirants.
The Accomplisher, who brings about all Siddhis (spiritual powers and perfections).
She who drinks the blood of her devotees in order to purify and re-energize them.
She who bestows joy and deep contentment upon the spiritual aspirant.
The Destroyer of the Enemies of Devotees.
The Knowledge of the Self, the Supreme Consciousness.
The Supreme Knowledge of Brahma, the Ultimate Reality.
The Consort of the Supreme Brahman, the Absolute Reality.
Abiding in the three peaks or three gunas.
The Five Principles inherent in Creation, Consciousness, Bliss, and Liberation.
The Essence and Dweller in all Forms and Bodies.
Comprising all colors and forms, embracing the whole of creation.
The One Who turns the alphabet into a rosary of japa, revealing the power hidden in the seed-sounds of creation.

pageGroups.meaning: The Dark-bodied Goddess of the Cremation Ground, the Power of Death and Dissolution.
The Black Goddess, Ruler of Time.
The All-auspicious Dark Mother.
She who bears the skull, showing Her transcendence over mortality and the cycle of creation.
The hidden and secret Dark Goddess.
The Great Dark Mother, beautiful and compassionate to devotees, and terrifying to their enemies.
The destroyer of opposition, especially the one who grants siddhis and protects those who attain them.
The affectionate or diminutive form of Kali, the Dark One, signifying her tender yet potent presence.
She who is the Dark Night of Time, signifying profound dissolution and the ultimate reality beyond all manifestation.
She who rests upon Mahakala, the great Lord of Time.
The consort of Kala Bhairava.
The Illuminator of the path of the spiritual lineage, revealing the essence of Kaula tradition.
The Granter of all desires.
The lovely and desired Goddess, the one who becomes the focus of divine love and devotion.
The One who holds all desire and aspiration within herself.
One whose very nature is loveliness and beauty.
Her body is smeared with the essence of musk.
She who walks with the majestic gait of the Lord of Elephants, symbolizing power and grace.
She whose entire body bears the color of the letter Ka, signifying Time and Ultimate Reality.
The Beautiful One who awakens desire in Kāma (the God of Love) and who is Herself the embodiment of all desires.
The Passionate One, inflamed with divine desire to destroy evil.
She who can assume any form at will, whether to protect devotees or destroy evil.
The Wish-Fulfilling Cow, bestowing all aspirations.
The One who comprises and embodies all Kālās (portions or phases of the Moon).
The Beloved One, charming and radiant.
The Embodiment of Desire itself, and the Granter of Desires.
The famed and supreme Red Goddess who abides in the sacred Yoni seat of Assam and fulfills desires.
The Protectress of the family, tradition, and spiritual lineage.
Dwelling in the Family, the Noble One.
The Mother of the Kula, or the Lineage of Devotees.
The Inaccessible and Invincible Mother, the Fortress that Protects.
She who destroys all misfortune and affliction.
The youthful and potent aspect of the Divine Mother, embodying the energy of Skanda (Kartikeya).
Born of Noble Lineage and the Remover of the three worldly fevers.
The all-attractive Dark One who draws all creation back unto herself.
Her body bears the dark hue of Kriishhna.
The dark-bellied Goddess whose depths hold the entire universe.
The dark-limbed Mother whose every limb reveals the depth of the primordial void.
She whose body is like a thunderbolt, indestructible and charged with irresistible power.
The One whose sound sets action in motion.
The Lotus-born Goddess, representing wealth, prosperity, and spiritual purity.
The One who measures out time to all beings, and is Death itself.
Possessing a frightful countenance.
And the one with an open mouth and projecting fangs, whose nature is terrifying.
The invincible Mother, the radiant ornament of all auspicious families.
The Fierce and Terrifying One, embodying intense, unbridled power.
The Fiercely Radiant One, whose splendor is overwhelming and awe-inspiring.
The Radiant One, Aglow with Divine Splendor.
The Mind of a Brahmin, as the enlightened and awakened consciousness.
Possessing immeasurable strength and power.
The Dark-bellied Goddess, who resembles a rain cloud.
The Child-like One, of tender age and pure heart.
The Ultimate Measure and Foundation of all Existence and Consciousness.
She Whose Smile is a Mudrā.
The creative Power or Shakti of Brahma.
The Power and Energy of Lord Narayana (Vishnu), Sustainer of the Universe.
The Auspicious One, granting beneficence and well-being.
The deeply auspicious and beautiful One, the gracious Mother who brings blessing and well-being.
The loving and motherly Protector of Devi's devotees.
The Great Goddess, the supreme Empress.
The Slayer of the demons Chanda and Munda.
The Boar-faced Goddess, the feminine power of Vishnu's Varaha avatar, who protects the earth and destroys demonic forces.
The feminine divine power of the Man-Lion incarnation, fierce and unyielding in protection.
Whose limbs are as hard and resilient as a thunderbolt.
She whose body is hard as a thunderbolt, the Vajra-bodied Kali.
Wearing a garland of human heads.
The auspicious, pure, and beneficent primal Power.
Adorned with garlands, especially skull-garlands, signifying Her mastery over death.
She who is adorned with a garland of human skulls.
Adorned with trickling blood, symbolizing Her fierce and life-sustaining power.
Her body is smeared with red sandalwood paste.
Her forehead is adorned with the brilliant red vermillion of victory and auspiciousness.
The Fierce and Terrifying One, whose form fills the unrighteous with awe and fear.
She who has terrible fangs.
She who is more terrifying than the most terrifying, yet also not terrifying.
The auspicious One, radiant with goodness.
The Great-Fanged One, whose fearsome teeth reveal Her power to consume creation and bring all things to dissolution.
The Great Enchantress, whose divine illusion creates and pervades the cosmos.
Having beautiful and radiant teeth, symbolizing purity and formidable power.
The One whose teeth mark the end of the Yuga, signifying ultimate destruction.
Possessing Beautiful Eyes.
The One with Fierce or Atypical Eyes, revealing Her all-seeing cosmic vision and formidable gaze.
She whose eyes are vast and beautiful, revealing all-encompassing vision and wisdom.
The Three-Eyed One.
Radiant as a beautiful autumnal moon.
Radiant One with a Gentle Smile.
Her whose eyes are like the lotus, charming and captivating all.
Her face beams with a mighty, resounding laugh.
Bearing a smiling face, radiating divine joy and benevolence.
She who speaks with beauty, truth, and auspicious force.
She whose face is a serene, blossoming lotus.
The smiling Goddess, ever blissful and benevolent.
The one whose words are pleasant and endearing.
The One whose eyes are like a deep cave, pervading all space and time.
The foremost and best in her clan, embodying its highest virtues.
The Great One, vast and exalted, whose light encompasses the universe.
She whose speech is abundant, eloquent, and charged with divine power.
The one with an auspicious mind and a benevolent disposition.
She who dispels evil thought and spiritual ignorance.
The fierce one, terrifying to all who oppose cosmic order.
The one who destroys the demons Chanda and Munda with tremendous speed.
The Fiercely Wrathful and Fiery One.
The fierce and wrathful dark Goddess who destroys all evil.
The incandescent fierce one, blazing with wrath against evil.
The Swift and Fierce Mother, whose passionate force overwhelms all obstacles.
Whose Hair is Beautiful.
With disheveled hair, symbolizing uncontrolled primal force.
She whose long, flowing hair expresses boundless power and untamed nature.
The Great-breasted One, signifying her immense nurturing and life-giving power.
Adorning Herself with the Ear-ornaments Fashioned from the Corpses of the Undead.
She whose hand holds a corpse and who is adorned with a girdle of corpses.
Seated upon a corpse, symbolizing mastery over death and the material world.
The Lover of Corpses.
She Whose Abode Is the Land of Corpses, revealing Her sovereignty over death, dissolution, and the thresholds of existence.
She Who Dwells in the Cremation Ground, revealing freedom from fear, death, and worldly attachment.
The sacred and meritorious one, embodying virtue and auspiciousness.
The Bestower of Merit and Righteousness.
The wise teacher of the Kula's esoteric practices, guiding the lineage toward enlightenment.
The Abode of Purity and Merit, the Sacred Dwelling.
Whose form is purity itself, the embodiment of virtue.
Of Pure and Sacred Glory.
One who purifies and sanctifies all.
The Purifier, the Holy One, the One who removes all impurity.
The Pure and Sanctifying One, who cleanses all impurities.
The Utmost Reality, the Supreme and Primordial Truth.
Adorned with the merits of past lives.
Whose name itself is sacred (to utter or remember).
The Remover of Fear, Dispeller of All Terrors.
The Bestower of Boons.
Wielder of the Sword, Protector of the Devotees.
Bearing a freshly severed human head and a sword in Her hands.
The Self-Decapitated Goddess, embodying self-sacrifice and the primal creative-destructive power.
She with a beautiful nose.
The Beneficent One who faces south and grants both spiritual liberation and earthly boons.
The Dark-Complexioned One, radiant like a storm cloud and adorned with three eyes.
Dark-hued, embodying the universe's profound mystery and all-encompassing nature.
The Peaceful One, embodying ultimate tranquility and serenity.
Whose breasts are high and firm.
Clothed by the Directions, signifying boundlessness and an unclad state.
Possessing a Frightful Roar, terrifying to her enemies.
The Consort and Supreme Power of Sri Kantha (Lord Shiva), whose auspicious presence adorns and empowers Him.
The Bearer of Blood, the One who carries the living current of life itself.
One who is ever united with Shiva.
Transcending all associations and attachments, being utterly free.
Enraptured and maddened by divine love, and intensely captivating.
The Intoxicated Mother, overflowing with divine ecstasy and power.
The Intoxicated Mother, wild with divine joy and power.
The Ecstatic One, intoxicated with divine joy.
Dwelling in the Ocean of Nectar.
The exceedingly intoxicated One, immersed in divine ecstasy and fervor.
The Great Fierce Intoxicated One, immersed in the ecstasy of liberation and destruction.
The One who draws all things to herself.
Fond of sacred songs and the Bhagavad Gita.
Engaged in instrumental music, delighting in its practice.
Engaged in the dance upon corpses, symbolizing her triumph over death and attachment.
The Four-Armed One, symbolizing complete power and all-encompassing dominion.
Possessing Ten Arms, signifying her omnipotence and capacity to wield many divine powers.
The eighteen-armed Goddess, whose form is both fierce and benevolent.
She who is the Daughter of Sage Katyayana.
The Mother of the Universe.
The Supreme Goddess of the World and the Universe.
The Friend and Kinswoman of the entire Universe.
Sustainer and Mother of the Universe.
The Giver of Bliss to the Whole Universe.
She who is the life and soul of the universe.
The Golden-hued Goddess, Daughter of the Himalayas.
The Great beyond the great, the supreme vastness beyond conception.
Adorned with a sacred thread of snakes.
The Serpent Goddess, embodying primal energy, transformation, and hidden wisdom.
She Who Reclines on the Cosmic Serpent, revealing divine rest as the ground of creation.
Dragon Maiden who dwells in the nether regions and guards forgotten treasures.
The Divine Maiden, a Daughter of the Gods.
The divine singer and celestial musician, embodying the enchanting melody of the cosmos.
The Sovereign Queen of the Kinnaras, celestial musicians and dancers.
The Night of Delusion, in which ignorance binds the soul yet also gives way to awakening.
The Great Night, embodying vast darkness, cosmic dissolution, and ultimate reality.
The Fierce and Terrible One, embodying destructive power against all unrighteousness.
The radiant slayer of the demon Bhasvara.
The Bearer of Wisdom and Knowledge.
The Possessor of Wealth, who grants abundance and prosperity.
A celestial being, a guardian spirit, or a nature spirit, often linked to riches and the hidden treasures of the earth.
The Goddess who abides in perfect union with the Divine and embodies yogic power and wisdom.
The destroyer who wipes out the old.
The terrifying female demoness form, expressing destructive force turned against evil.
The Yogini who bears a skull and trident and grants siddhis.
The Embodiment and Essence of all Sacred Knowledge and the Vedas.
Adorned with the wisdom of the Vedas, embodying their deepest truths.
The sacred Vedic revelation, the divine knowledge that is heard.
The Goddess who is the living essence of sacred tradition and memory.
The Great Wisdom, embodying the ten primal forms of divine knowledge and liberation.
The secret knowledge, revealed only to those prepared and worthy to receive it.
The Ancient One, eternally existing before all creation.
She who is beyond thought, yet ever meditated upon.
Beyond thought and comprehension, She who cannot be conceived by the mind.
The innate power within offerings, the sustenance of the Pitris, and the very principle of truth.
The sacred oblation itself, carrying the offering to the divine.
The embodiment of deep sleep, cosmic slumber, and the hidden power of unconsciousness.
She who abides in profound yogic slumber and inward absorption.
The Daughter of the Mountain, eternally joined with Shiva.
One who subsists without even leaves, embodying absolute austerity and detachment.
The Immovable One, Steadfast and Unwavering.
The Trembling One, alive with dynamic movement and intensity.
The source of all knowledge and learning.
The Ascetic, She who performs austerities, embodying intense spiritual discipline and fierce resolve.
The sacred celestial river, the descending current of divine grace that purifies the world.
The light that shines within the forehead, the inner radiance of awakened consciousness.
She who is Indra's consort and embodies strength and beauty.
The Furrowed Earth, the Divine Consort of Rama, embodiment of purity and courage.
The pure and chaste one, the embodiment of truth, existence, and essential reality.
The Supreme Truth, the Ultimate Goal of Devotion.
The Eternal Guide, embodying justice, right conduct, and righteous order.
Endowed with excellent moral conduct and discipline.
Of Excellent Radiance and Delight.
The embodiment of contentment, satisfaction, and inner peace.
Nourishment, growth, and prosperity embodied.
She who embodies patience, steadfastness, and unwavering resolve.
The Embodiment of Forgiveness and Patience.
The Goddess of speech, eloquence, and wisdom, abiding in the tongue.
The embodiment of supreme intelligence and discernment.
The Great Goddess of fortune, abundance, and spiritual prosperity.
The auspicious Divine Mother of wealth, prosperity, and fortune, both material and spiritual.
The Blue Saraswati, bestowing articulate wisdom and guiding speech towards liberation.
The River-like Goddess, whose current carries power and sustenance.
The flowing essence of knowledge, arts, and wisdom, personified as the Goddess of eloquence and inspiration.
The inner sound or subtle music heard in the hidden realm of existence, from which speech and ultimate knowledge arise.
The Victorious One, who leads all toward the highest triumph.
The Victorious One, eternally triumphant over all forces of darkness and ignorance.
The Divine Mother as the life-giving rivers that flow into the great oceans.
The All-pervasive One, immanent in all existence.
The Deliverer and Rescuer who carries beings across the ocean of worldly existence, the Star Goddess who guides and protects.
Dweller in the Absolute Void or Emptiness, the formless Reality beyond all manifestation.
The Pure One, untainted by Maya or delusion.
The Flowing River, the ceaseless current of Shakti.
The Embodiment of Intelligence, Wisdom, and Mental Acuity.
The goddess who devours all sustenance and offers protection.
Embodying countless forms, appearing through infinite manifestations.
The Gross Form, Ponderous and Manifest in the Material Universe.
The Subtle One, beyond material perception and manifestation.
The subtle and minutest star, guiding from within.
The Divine Mother who holds all six auspicious opulences and sovereign dominion over the cosmos.
The Passionate One, Filled with Love and Affection.
The Supreme Bliss personified.
The Embodiment of Consciousness and Bliss.
The One who is Pervaded by all Bliss.
The Eternal One, beyond all cycles of creation and dissolution.
The embodiment of all bliss and joy.
The Giver of Auspicious Fortune and Well-being.
The Delightful One, the Bestower of Joy and Prosperity.
The Glorified and Praised One, worthy of all hymns and adoration.
Worthy of praise, the one who is extolled.
She who is self-existent, abiding inherently in her own nature.
The Delighter, or the One who is Full of Delight.
The One who overcomes all difficulties and obstacles with great power.
The Variegated One, Whose Form is Diverse and Wondrous.
The Wonderfully Variegated, The Multi-faceted and Diverse.
The Beautiful and Wondrous One.
The Lotus-born Divine Mother and Giver of Light.
The one who dwells in the lotus.
With a lotus-like face, embodying beauty and spiritual purity.
Adorned with Lotus Flowers, blossoming in divine beauty.
The powerful Shakti, the Goddess who dwells in and acts through the six chakras.
Endowed with patience and forbearance.
The auspicious Goddess whose essence abides as the vibrant power of the root chakra.
Fond of blood, especially the purified sacrificial offering.
The Deluder, who casts evil beings into confusion.
The Giver of Existence and the Sustainer of the Universe.
The consort of Rudra (Shiva), embodying His fierce and destructive aspects.
The Destroyer of All Forms of Misery.
The Destroyer of Enemies.
The consort of Upendra (Vishnu), signifying her cosmic supremacy and universal power.
The great Queen of Indra, embodying majestic power and sovereign authority.
The Luminous One, emanating moonlight and dispelling darkness.
The Moon-faced Mother, whose form is radiant and serene like the moon.
The Soul and Essence of the Sun.
The Consort of Rudra, the Fierce Aspect of Shiva, embodying destruction and fierce compassion.
The Fierce and Terrifying One, the embodiment of cosmic wrath and destruction.
The primordial Feminine Nature, embodying the creative potency of the universe.
The primordial Male Principle, Purusha, the attributeless ground of consciousness.
The Supreme Power and living Energy that pervades all existence, the Divine Feminine itself.
The One Whose Beautiful Words Are a Form of Wisdom and Truth.
The innate intelligence and understanding that guides all beings.
The Divine Mother of the Universe.
She who grants liberation from the cycle of birth and death and delights in divine bliss.
The Liberator, who grants ultimate freedom and Moksha.
The faithful and devoted wife, embodying unwavering fidelity to her consort.
The Supreme Sovereign of All, the Goddess who rules over all existence.
The Mother of all, the universal Mother Goddess.
The Archer and Destroyer of Demons, granting salvation and protection to devotees.
The Beloved Spouse of Shiva, the Remover of all Miseries.
The Omniscient One, possessing all knowledge and complete understanding.
The Bestower of Spiritual Powers.
The One who is Perfectly Accomplished and Ever-Ready for Action.
The auspicious, beautiful, and blissful One.
Dispeller of all fears.
The Creator of all beings and the universe.
The Remover of all miseries and the one who devours all.
The Protectress and Preserver of all Creation.
The Night that is wholly dark.
The embodiment of compassion and mercy toward all beings.
The profound Darkness that pervades all.
The Obscure One, who dispels the darkness of ignorance.
The Immovable, Steady, and Steadfast One who embodies the eternal and unchanging essence.
The Steadfast and Unmoving One, embodying eternal permanence amid change.
Steadfast, resolute, the courageous one whose wisdom remains unshaken.
The beautifully formed one, whose four-limbed form is exquisitely captivating.
The Ever-Moving One, forever in dynamic flux.
She whose Tongue is Frenzied and Hanging Out.
Whose life and deeds are supremely beautiful and auspicious.
The Abode of Modesty and Humility.
The Modest and Bashful One.
The modesty and bashfulness that covers one like a garment.
She who is beyond shame, modesty, and every limiting boundary, revealing absolute freedom.
The embodiment of modesty, humility, and spiritual conscience, essential to inner purity and ethical conduct.
The Royal One, endowed with kingly splendor and authority.
The Embodiment of Truth, whose very being is truth.
Steadfast in Righteousness, the upholder of Cosmic Order.
The Most Excellent and Supreme, embodying the highest virtues in their fullest form.
The merciless one who roars like the clouds.
The Heaviest, Greatest, and Most Important.
The Destroyer of Evil.
The Most Distinguished and Excellent One, unique in Her Supreme Being.
She who is the source and giver of the highest good, auspiciousness, and true prosperity.
The embodiment of compassion and deep sympathy, showering grace upon all beings.
The Terrifying One, striking fear into Her adversaries and awe into all who behold Her power.
The Terrifying One, who fills adversaries with dread yet stands as the fierce protectress of Her devotees.
She whose roar is terrifying.
She who inspires tremendous awe and sacred dread.
She whose effulgence pervades all.
Sovereign of Speech and Wisdom, embodying the power of eloquent expression.
The Auspicious One, who holds all radiance and prosperity.
The sacred dark river goddess, born of the sun, whose waters purify all sins.
The Performer of Sacrifices.
She who is especially dear to sacrificial rites, above all those prescribed by the Yajur Veda.
The abode of the knowledge enshrined within the Rigveda, Samaveda, and Atharvaveda.
